design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and function-first. High contrast with dense, scanable 'Control Room' grids. Color is functional only, using gold accents strictly for XAUUSD branding and data highlights.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID (Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, tight gap-4 or gap-6, every pixel utilized).
spacing_and_layout.borders: Exposed grid borders (border-collapse style) or 1px subtle borders (border-border) with flat backgrounds. No soft shadows.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px) to maintain the Swiss Brutalist rigid feel.

surfaces_and_components.cards: Flat solid background (bg-card), sharp 1px border (border-border), no rounded corners. On hover: border darkens, slight shadow-sm.
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Primary: Solid Gold (bg-primary) with black text. Secondary: Outline with sharp corners. Hover: -translate-y-[1px] with hard drop shadow.
surfaces_and_components.inputs_and_forms: Shadcn UI forms, heavily customized to have 0px border-radius, pure white background, 1px solid border. Use Shadcn Slider for risk % and Select for Strategy Mode.
surfaces_and_components.header: Solid Background (bg-background) with a hard 1px bottom border (border-border). No glassmorphism.
surfaces_and_components.data_visualization: Recharts for performance metrics. High contrast lines. Use JetBrains Mono for tick labels. Avoid using colors purely for decoration.

animation_and_motion.hover_states: Crisp, instantaneous color swaps or slight rigid translations (-translate-y-1). No overly smooth/bouncy spring animations.
animation_and_motion.loading: Use mono-spaced ASCII art spinners or fast, precise linear progress bars.

icons_and_assets.icon_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight for a technical feel)

images.description: Minimalist 3D render of a golden sphere intersecting with data charts, used as the main hero visual for the EA Overview.
Macro photo of sleek computer chip with golden circuitry, to be used in the System Architecture Documentation section.
Abstract 3D architectural landscape for the Risk Management Dashboard backdrop.
Candlestick chart image for market analysis visualization mockups.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update tailwind.config.js to use the HSL variables specified in colors section, and override border-radius to '0px' to ensure rigid Swiss style.
Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 for the dashboard layout (sidebar + main content) or a dense bento grid for widgets.
Implement the Parameter Configurator Panel using Shadcn Forms/Sliders/Selects. Ensure inputs have sharp corners (rounded-none).
For the Performance Metrics Display, use Shadcn/Recharts to create high-contrast bar/line charts using the specified chart colors.
Ensure the EA Download Section is prominent with a high-contrast Gold (bg-primary) CTA button.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='download-ea-button').
Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric financial data points (win rate, profit factor, prices).
Ensure high contrast check: text on background must have minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
